data.name: FmSummary
data.value:
Fieldmatics is a SaaS platform I am designing and building for growers. Its goal is to bring every greenhouse, field and olive grove into one place: the current conditions of each location, their full history and, next, alerts and automated irrigation. It works with any sensor hardware, and every customer's data stays private.

Under the hood it is a modular .NET 10 platform with Blazor, PostgreSQL, MQTT and RabbitMQ.

data.name: FmTagline
data.value: A SaaS platform that helps growers see what is happening in every greenhouse, field and grove, and next, act on it automatically.

data.name: FmProblemText
data.value: Growers look after many different places, often far apart: greenhouses, gardens, fields and olive groves. Conditions change by the hour: a hot afternoon, a dry patch of soil, a cold night. Without data, problems are noticed late, water is wasted and decisions rely on guesswork. Most IoT tools don't fix this, because they are built around specific hardware and show devices, not places.

data.name: FmValueIntro
data.value: What the platform is being built to give growers. Features marked “Coming next” are on the roadmap.

data.name: FmVal1Text
data.value: Current temperature, humidity and soil moisture for each greenhouse, field or grove, in one place and from any browser. You pick a place, not a device.

data.name: FmVal2Text
data.value: Every reading is kept and never deleted. Trends show what happened overnight, last week or across a whole season, so decisions rest on facts instead of guesswork.

data.name: FmVal3Text
data.value: Start with affordable sensors and add others later: Arduino-based today, wireless and industrial devices tomorrow. No lock-in to a single hardware vendor.

data.name: FmVal4Text
data.value: Rules notify you the moment a value leaves its safe range, such as a greenhouse overheating or soil drying out, so you can act before plants suffer.

data.name: FmVal5Text
data.value: Water only when the soil actually needs it, saving water and time, with a fail-safe design so that a fault never floods or dries out a field.

data.name: FmVal6Text
data.value: A cloud service: sign in from anywhere, and updates are handled by the platform. Each customer's data is kept private and separate from everyone else's.

data.name: FmHowTitle
data.value: How it works for a grower

data.name: FmHowIntro
data.value: From the first setup to a system that works for you. Some of these steps are still being built.

data.name: FmStep1Text
data.value: Create the places you grow in, such as Greenhouse 1, the north olive grove or the balcony, and name the sensors in each one.

data.name: FmStep2Text
data.value: A small connector next to the hardware sends the readings to Fieldmatics. Any kind of sensor can join; each technology simply gets its own connector.

data.name: FmStep3Text
data.value: Measurements flow in around the clock. They wait safely in line until they are stored, so nothing is lost if part of the platform restarts.

data.name: FmStep4Text
data.value: Open a location to see its current conditions first, then how they changed over time.

data.name: FmStep5Text
data.value: Set rules once and let Fieldmatics alert you or start the irrigation when conditions call for it.

data.name: FmPictureIntro
data.value: Fieldmatics sits between the growing environment and the grower. Any hardware connects through a small connector, and the platform keeps the data safe and turns it into insight and, later, action.

data.name: FmDiagTenantsText
data.value: Every customer uses the same, always up-to-date platform, but each one only ever sees their own locations and data.

data.name: FmTrust1Text
data.value: Readings wait in a safe queue and are only removed once they are stored, so a restart on the platform side doesn't leave gaps in your history.

data.name: FmTrust2Text
data.value: Each customer account is kept apart on the server, and ownership comes from the data itself, never from what a device or app claims.

data.name: FmTrust3Text
data.value: Sensors can be switched off or retired, but their readings are never deleted, so long-term trends stay complete.

data.name: FmTrust4Text
data.value: New kinds of sensors, new features and new customers fit in without redesigning the platform. Its internal boundaries are checked automatically on every change.

data.name: FmStackText
data.value: Under the hood, Fieldmatics is a modular .NET 10 platform: a Blazor web app, PostgreSQL for the history, and MQTT and RabbitMQ to move readings reliably.
